# FlatMMO Companion

> Public FlatMMO-specific knowledge and deterministic grounding layer.

Human companion: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/
Canonical AI page: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/ai.html
Canonical JSON context: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-context.json
Text fallback: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-context.txt

Important:
- FlatMMO is independent. Missing facts must not be inferred from RuneScape or other games.
- Consult the mechanics-rule status before calculations.
- Sleep Points and Run steps are separate systems.
- Exact combat hit chance, DPS, kill time, survivability and recommended levels remain unsupported until formulas are verified.
- The public grounding files contain no individual player's live/private snapshot.

Current domains:
- monsters: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-monsters.json
- quests (19 core records): https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-quests.json
- observed quest/mechanics overrides: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-overrides.json
- skills: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-skills.json
- mechanics: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-mechanics.json
- mechanics/readiness rules: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-rules.json
- areas: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-areas.json
- equipment: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-equipment.json
- sources: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-sources.json
- status: https://etherealaporia-alt.github.io/FlatMMO-Companion/flatmmo-status.json

The canonical JSON context merges the two observation-backed quest placeholders into the 19 core quest records for 21 named quests.
